name: 5 Segond
reason: 5 Segond is a criminal armed group operating in Haiti. 5 Segond is responsible for killings, rape and other forms of sexual and gender-based violence, kidnapping, extortion, theft, piracy, obstruction of humanitarian aid, attacks against civilians and civilian infrastructure, and arms and drug trafficking. 5 Segond has committed grave violations against children, including sexual violence. Members of 5 Segond were identified as responsible for the rape of two girls, aged 3 and 12, at a site for internally displaced persons in March 2024. The group has also carried out attacks affecting health infrastructure and humanitarian services. 5 Segond is therefore responsible for serious human rights violations and abuses, including systematic and widespread sexual and gender-based violence.

name: 400 Mawozo
reason: 400 Mawozo is a criminal armed group operating in Haiti. 400 Mawozo is responsible for the recruitment and exploitation of children, exposing them to armed violence and other serious abuses. 400 Mawozo is further responsible for killings, rape and other forms of sexual and gender-based violence, including rape of minors, kidnapping, attacks against civilians, looting, destruction of public property, hijacking of trucks, attacks disrupting humanitarian assistance, and forced displacement. 400 Mawozo is therefore responsible for serious human rights violations and abuses, killings, and systematic and widespread sexual and gender-based violence.

name: Gran Ravine
reason: Gran Ravine is a criminal armed group operating in Haiti. Gran Ravine is responsible for killings, rape and other forms of sexual and gender-based violence, kidnapping, attacks against civilians, destruction of property, and other acts of violence against civilian populations. Under the leadership of Renel Destina, alias “Ti Lapli”, Gran Ravine has committed murder, rape, kidnapping, and other serious crimes. The group has carried out attacks resulting in civilian deaths, displacement, and the disruption of essential services. Gran Ravine is therefore responsible for serious human rights violations and abuses, including killings and systematic and widespread sexual and gender-based violence.
